title: presence
description: How many clients are attached to the session now, the receiving one included: every attachment the host counts (pending, live or closing, not one whose peer has half-closed) and, on a TUI-hosted session, the hosting TUI's own seat — the count a sessions.list row's attached carries. Sent only by a host whose session capability presence is true: on each attachment once its synchronized has been written, then whenever the count changes, the latest value only and at most two a second, until the attachment ends (never after its reset or its detach's reply). It has no seq: it is none of the session's events, and is never sequenced or journalled. A client that does not know it ignores it.
